notes: D1 oracle is docs/lausanne-d1/oracle-clash-report.md, which itself already hand-transcribed the M1 and M2 station rosters (from French Wikipedia, cross-referenced against English Wikipedia and the official t-l.ch map) into its 'Station roster (D1 transcription, 6 Sep 2026)' section. This pack's stations[]/termini reshape that transcription verbatim into D1 pack format. Do not generate published-network.json from GTFS (oracle report explicit instruction). No stopIds in this file.

City id lausanne is unused in existing packs. Display Lausanne. Agency TL (Transports publics de la région lausannoise). Do not invent city=laus, city=lsn, city=vd, and do not merge into another Swiss city (Zürich is a separate, unrelated pack in this same wave).
City stays planned. assertCityLive("lausanne") must fail (city not in lib/providers/registry.js CITIES).

Modes v1: TL METRO M1 + M2 ONLY. No M3 (infrastructure concession approved June 2026, building permits pending, no confirmed construction start/opening date — out until officially open). No S-Bahn/SBB regional-mainline (out-mode, v1 metro-only cut). No buses. No funicular. No LEB integration as a metro line (LEB R20 at Lausanne-Flon is `in` on the board-eligibility table but stays a separate service, not a line in this file's lines[]).

Station roster (28 total, locked per oracle report): M1 = 15 stations, Lausanne-Flon to Renens-Gare. M2 = 14 stations, Ouchy-Olympique to Croisettes. Lausanne-Flon is shared between the two rosters (M1 terminus, M2 through-call) so the unique station count is 15 + 14 - 1 = 28.

Hub lock: LAUSANNE-FLON. Only station where M1 and M2 both call (M1 eastern terminus; M2 call between Grancy and Riponne-Maurice-Béjart). Verified on the official TL map per the oracle report. Lausanne-Flon is a hub stop string, never a direction token. LEB R20 commuter rail also calls at Lausanne-Flon on a separate lower platform level - doNotGroup, not a second metro line at this hub.
Rejected alternative hub: Lausanne-Gare (M2 only; also CFF/SBB mainline). Oracle report: 'not a true hub for metro, so not locked.' Kept only as a documented alternative, not used as the lock.

doNotGroup: Lausanne-Flon (TL metro M1 x M2) vs LEB Lausanne-Echallens-Bercher R20 (separate operator, separate lower platform level). LEB R20 is walk-up boardable and `in` on the board-eligibility table but is a distinct service with its own route identifiers - never merge into the metro board at Flon.

doNotGroup: Lausanne-Gare (TL metro M2 only) vs CFF/SBB mainline. Shared address, separate platforms. CFF regional trains here are walk-up boardable and `in`; SBB S-Bahn/long-distance is `out-mode` by the v1 metro-only cut. Metro and CFF stay on separate boards regardless of eligibility overlap.
doNotGroup: Renens-Gare (TL metro M1 only) vs CFF/SBB regional. Same shape as Lausanne-Gare: shared address, separate platforms, CFF walk-up boardable and `in`, S-Bahn `out-mode`.
Timezone Europe/Zurich HAS DST (UTC+1 standard / UTC+2 summer, last Sunday March-last Sunday October). Do not copy Perth/Brisbane no-DST assumptions.
